 HBCU Football's Separation Saturday | HBCU LEGENDS HBCU Football Week 11: Championship Scores, Separation Saturday's How to Watch, and TV/Streaming Schedule 
 The CIAA and SIAC crown champions Saturday, while North Carolina Central faces SC State in a MEAC first-place showdown and teams battle for SWAC division leads. Here's where to watch 20 HBCU football games Nov. 12-14. Kyle Mosley | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source HBCU Football's Separation Saturday | HBCU LEGENDS In this story:
